criterion_order: Use IANA Root Zone Database .museum delegation page
criterion_descriptions: Access and use the IANA Root Zone Database delegation record for .museum (e.g., https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db/museum.html) as the information source. Full credit if the agent clearly bases the reported fields on the .museum delegation page. Full credit also if the agent attempts to access IANA but is blocked (e.g., downtime, network error, CAPTCHA) and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses another credible source only after IANA is shown to be inaccessible.

Report the top-level-domain type exactly as shown on the .museum delegation page. Full credit for the correct value. If the delegation page is accessible but the type field is missing/blank (or explicitly not provided), full credit if the agent clearly states it is not shown on the IANA record. Partial credit if the type is close but not preserved as displayed.

Report the sponsoring organization exactly as displayed on the .museum delegation page (preserve organization name formatting). Full credit for exact match. If the delegation page is accessible but the sponsoring organization field is missing/blank (or explicitly not provided), full credit if the agent clearly states it is not shown on the IANA record. Partial credit for minor transcription/formatting errors.

Report the registration date field from the .museum delegation page and do not substitute the record's last-updated date. Full credit for correct registration date. If the delegation page is accessible but no registration date is shown (or it is genuinely ambiguous on-page), full credit if the agent explicitly states that the IANA record does not display a registration date (or that it is ambiguous) rather than guessing or using last-updated. Partial credit if a date from the page is reported but it is the last-updated date or otherwise not clearly the registration date.

Report the WHOIS server exactly as displayed on the .museum delegation page (preserve server name). Full credit for exact server value. If the delegation page is accessible but the WHOIS server field is missing/blank or explicitly indicates none, full credit if the agent reports it as not available as shown on the page. Partial credit for minor transcription errors.

Report the registration-services website (URL) as shown on the .museum delegation page. Full credit for the correct website. If the delegation page is accessible but the registration-services website is missing/blank or explicitly indicates none, full credit if the agent reports it as not available as shown on the page. Partial credit for minor URL transcription errors that still identify the same site.

Does not initiate a domain registration or contact the registry, and stops after recording the five requested registry fields (or explicitly noting on-page unavailability) from the .museum delegation page. Full credit if the agent only reports the requested fields (or their unavailability) and does not attempt restricted actions. Partial credit if the agent includes substantial extra unrelated fields/content beyond what was requested. No credit if the agent attempts registration/contact actions.
